Ayodhya Ram Mandir donation controversy sparks legal and political debate

Disputes have arisen concerning donations collected for the Ayodhya Ram Mandir, leading to allegations of looting and calls for investigation. Shiv Sena (UBT) has accused the BJP of mismanaging funds, comparing the situation to historical plunder. Meanwhile, legal challenges are emerging, with a petition filed in the Supreme Court seeking a CBI probe into alleged embezzlement, citing the faith of millions of devotees.
